verdict.rationale: Vercel's CLI docs say it can 'replicate your deployment environment locally', and the platform manages a distinct local environment with its own variables. That is a first-party claim of local production parity. Beyond that one-line mention, there is no detail on a local runtime simulator, how faithful it is to production, or what it covers. Missing for 10: a documented local dev server or simulator command, specifics on how closely it matches the production runtime (functions, middleware, Fluid compute), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime

citations.quote: Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
